name: cn.yyxx.eyuangame.core.impl.center.HybridActivity
description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game SDK opens this Activity with a page address when a game feature needs an in-game web page; it displays the page, handles links and file selection, and passes page actions back to the game.
disableEffect: Game features that use these web pages, including their links or file selection, will not work.
